value.rationale: This is the complete homotopy type of the full geometric symmetry quotient of a canonical five-by-five queen placement complex, already known to have an infinite-cyclic loop and 17 two-sphere classes before quotienting. It resolves whether the entire board symmetry kills π1 and how many integral spherical classes remain, a motivated orbit-space invariant not supplied by placing counts or ordinary homotopy type.
